name: Kuching Marathon 2026 (KM2026)
short_description: Kuching Marathon 2026 (KM2026) is a full marathon, half marathon, 10km, and 5km event held 27 September 2026 in Kuching, Sarawak, Malaysia.
ai_summary: The Kuching Marathon 2026 (KM2026) takes place on 27 September 2026 at Padang Merdeka in Kuching, Sarawak, Malaysia. Organized by the Kuching Marathon Association, the event offers four distance options: full marathon (42.195km), half marathon (21.1km), 10km, and 5km. Registration is currently open, with prices ranging from RM60 to RM160 depending on the chosen distance.
pros: Multiple distance options (5km, 10km, 21.1km, 42.195km) suit runners of varying experience levels
Centrally located at Padang Merdeka in Kuching, Sarawak
Affordable pricing range from RM60 to RM160

faqs.question: When is the Kuching Marathon 2026 taking place?
faqs.answer: The Kuching Marathon 2026, also known as KM2026, is scheduled to take place on 27 September 2026. The event will be held at Padang Merdeka in Kuching, Sarawak, Malaysia. Registration for this race is currently open for interested participants.

faqs.question: What distances can I run at KM2026?
faqs.answer: KM2026 offers four distance categories for participants to choose from: a full marathon of 42.195km, a half marathon of 21.1km, a 10km race, and a 5km race. This range allows runners of different fitness levels and experience to select an appropriate distance.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to register for KM2026?
faqs.answer: Registration fees for the Kuching Marathon 2026 range from RM60 to RM160, depending on which distance category a participant chooses to enter. The exact price within this range will vary based on the specific race distance selected, such as the 5km, 10km, half marathon, or full marathon.

faqs.question: Who organizes the Kuching Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The Kuching Marathon 2026 is organized by the Kuching Marathon Association. The race is held at Padang Merdeka in Kuching, Sarawak, Malaysia, and registration for the event is currently open to runners interested in participating in any of the four available distances.
